news.title: New Publication in Lab on a Chip
news.excerpt: Our latest research on advanced microfluidic systems for MiMic applications has been published in the prestigious Lab on a Chip journal. The paper presents novel design principles for creating more physiologically relevant tissue models.

news.title: Dr. Bianchi Wins Best Poster Award at MicroTAS 2024
news.excerpt: Congratulations to Dr. Maria Bianchi for receiving the Best Poster Award at the 28th International Conference on Miniaturized Systems for Chemistry and Life Sciences. Her work on heart MiMic biosensors was recognized for its innovation and impact.

news.title: Workshop: Microfluidic Device Fabrication
news.excerpt: Join us for a hands-on workshop on microfluidic device fabrication and characterization. The two-day event will cover soft lithography, PDMS molding, and device validation techniques. Registration now open for graduate students and researchers.

news.title: Lab Featured in Nature Reviews Bioengineering
news.excerpt: Our research on multi-organ platforms has been highlighted in a comprehensive review article in Nature Reviews Bioengineering. The article discusses the future of microphysiological systems in drug development.

news.title: New ERC Starting Grant Awarded
news.excerpt: Prof. Rossi has been awarded a prestigious ERC Starting Grant totaling €1.5M for the project 'Advanced MiMic Systems with Multi-Modal Sensing'. The five-year project will push the boundaries of microfluidic biosensor integration.

news.title: International Collaboration Announced with MIT
news.excerpt: We are excited to announce a new research collaboration with Professor Linda Griffith's laboratory at MIT. The partnership will focus on developing multi-MiMic systems for studying liver-immune system interactions.

news.title: PhD Defense: Congratulations to Dr. Alessandro Ferrari
news.excerpt: Alessandro Ferrari successfully defended his PhD thesis titled 'Gut MiMic Systems with Integrated Microbiome for Host-Microbe Interaction Studies'. Congratulations Dr. Ferrari on this outstanding achievement!

news.title: Seminar: Dr. Jennifer Lewis (Harvard University)
news.excerpt: We are hosting Dr. Jennifer Lewis from Harvard University for a seminar on 3D bioprinting of vascularized tissues. The talk will be held on November 25th at 3:00 PM in DEIB Auditorium. All are welcome to attend.

news.title: Lab Welcomes Three New PhD Students
news.excerpt: We are delighted to welcome three new PhD students to our team: Laura Galli (working on kidney-on-chip), Davide Costa (blood-brain barrier models), and Chiara Martini (cancer metastasis platforms). Welcome aboard!

news.title: Presenting at Organ-on-Chip World Summit 2023
news.excerpt: Our lab will present four talks and three posters at the MiMic World Summit in Boston next month. Topics include cardiac modeling, liver toxicity platforms, and biosensor integration.

news.title: New Industry Partnership with Roche Pharmaceuticals
news.excerpt: We have established a strategic partnership with Roche Pharmaceuticals to develop MiMic platforms for early-stage drug toxicity screening. The collaboration includes funding for two postdoctoral researchers.

news.title: Open PhD Positions Available
news.excerpt: We have two fully-funded PhD positions available starting in Spring 2024. Topics include multi-organ platforms and biosensor development. Application deadline: December 15, 2023. See our Join Us page for details.
